==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
The core conflict of this dream was a battle between two super powered women. One of them was a winged warrior. The other was armed with a black whip.
Whip Woman used to be allies with the Winged Warrior. They once worked together to control the planet. But I was able to help convince Whip Woman to become a hero.

I did this by shapeshifting into an older version of Whip Woman while fighting Winged Warrior. I think I helped show her that she could be a hero. Sometimes inspiration is the only superpower you need.
